name: OnePlus (all models)

charge_control.note: OnePlus 5 to 8 (OxygenOS msm kernels): 1 stops charging.
OnePlus 9 and later (OPLUS kernels shared with Oppo and Realme): 0 stops charging. Uncertain: verify.
Qualcomm: suspends USB input, so the phone runs from the battery while charging is stopped.

autoboot.note: Try 'fastboot oem off-mode-charge 0' after unlocking (tools/phase0/phase0.sh autoboot --fastboot); not every OnePlus bootloader accepts it. Otherwise a root change that makes the charging-only mode boot Android. Prove it with tools/phase0/phase0.sh autoboot --test.

notes: Manufacturer-only match: any OnePlus phone without a more specific profile. Narrow it with model_regex (Build.MODEL, for example '^IN20' for the OnePlus 8 family) once a phone passes Phase 0.
current_now on OnePlus kernels is often negative while charging and sometimes in milliamps: measure with tools/phase0/phase0.sh current-sign and set unit and sign.
OnePlus kernels may also expose battery protection limits in Settings; use them as a base layer under the Agent's limit.
